description: Provenance artifacts for the ANXA2R assessment: membrane-anchor benchmark table, evidence matrix, GO decision table, and a combined summary figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, json, os
OUT="/agent/jobs/c66b88c8-ca85-4b2f-8912-236606c1f8b3/provenance"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

S=("MEQHFLGCVKRAWDSAEVAPEPQPPPIVSSEDRGPWPLPLYPVLGEYSLDSCDLGLLSSPCWRLPGVYWQNGLSPGVQSTLEPSTAKPTEFSWPGTQKQQEAPVEEVGQAEEPDRLRLQQ"
   "LPWSSPLHPWDRQQDTEVCDSGCLLERRHPPALQPWRHLPGFSDCLEWILRVGFAAFSVLWACCSRICGAKQP")
HESSA={'A':0.11,'C':-0.13,'D':3.49,'E':2.68,'F':-0.32,'G':0.74,'H':2.06,'I':-0.60,'K':2.71,'L':-0.55,'M':-0.10,
       'N':2.05,'P':2.23,'Q':2.36,'R':2.58,'S':0.84,'T':0.52,'V':-0.31,'W':0.30,'Y':0.68}
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,
    'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}

bench = pd.DataFrame([
 ("ITGB1","P05556","integrin beta-1, type I single-pass",-3.84,3.05,"membrane"),
 ("EGFR","P00533","EGF receptor, type I single-pass",-3.46,2.77,"membrane"),
 ("CD4","P01730","T-cell co-receptor, type I single-pass",-2.55,2.64,"membrane"),
 ("TFRC","P02786","transferrin receptor, type II single-pass",-1.83,2.43,"membrane"),
 ("SEC61B","P60468","tail-anchored ER protein",-0.28,2.41,"membrane"),
 ("CD59","P13987","GPI-anchored (cleaved GPI signal)",1.22,2.11,"membrane"),
 ("ANXA2R","Q3ZCQ2","query protein",3.68,1.54,"query"),
 ("CNOT1","A5YKK6","CCR4-NOT scaffold, cytoplasmic",4.62,1.72,"soluble"),
 ("ANXA2","P07355","peripheral membrane, Ca2+/phospholipid",7.98,1.08,"soluble"),
 ("GAPDH","P04406","cytosolic enzyme",8.62,1.06,"soluble"),
], columns=["gene","acc","description","min_dG19_kcal_mol","max_KD19","class"])
bench.to_csv(f"{OUT}/anxa2r_membrane_anchor_benchmark.csv",index=False)
print(bench.to_string(index=False))

evid = pd.DataFrame([
 ("PMID:16895901","direct assay / cloning","competing (source of the claim)","ANXA2R is a type I plasma-membrane receptor for annexin A2",
  "125I-annexin II binding to PSV10 stromal cells: single class of sites, Kd 5.79 nM, Bmax 2.13e5/cell; expression cloning from a human marrow cDNA library in NIH3T3 identified a clone encoding a '26-kDa type I membrane receptor protein' in HEK293; anti-receptor antibody blocked annexin II-induced osteoclast formation",
  "Human marrow stromal cells (PSV10), NIH3T3 and HEK293 transfectants","Single study, never independently replicated; topology asserted, not mapped (no protease protection, no surface biotinylation, no N-glycosylation mapping); cross-linked species reacted with anti-p11 (S100A10), not anti-p36"),
 ("This work (computational)","structural / computational","refutes","ANXA2R has a signal peptide and a transmembrane helix",
  "No signal peptide (max KD w=7 over res 1-30 = 0.89; 5 Pro in res 18-30); no TM window (max KD19 = 1.54; best 19-aa dG(app) = +3.68 kcal/mol vs -3.84 to +1.22 for six membrane-anchored controls); no N-myristoylation (res 2 = Glu); no CaaX; no GPI signal",
  "UniProt Q3ZCQ2 canonical, MANE ENST00000616064","Prediction only; benchmarked internally against positive and negative controls computed identically"),
 ("This work (AlphaFold DB AF-Q3ZCQ2-F1 v6)","structural / computational","refutes","ANXA2R folds into a ligand-binding ectodomain",
  "Mean pLDDT 55.7, 0% of residues >90, 88% <70; mean PAE 25.97 A; Rg(CA) 38.3 A vs 16.3 A expected for a folded 193-aa globule and 42.6 A for a random coil; single helix-basin segment at res 162-187, rest coil/extended",
  "AlphaFold2 model, human sequence","Model, not experiment; low pLDDT is itself the evidence of disorder"),
 ("This work (Foldseek 3Di-AA vs afdb50 / afdb-swissprot / pdb100)","structural / computational","refutes","ANXA2R has structural relatives that would hint at receptor function",
  "0 hits in afdb50 and pdb100; only the self-hit in afdb-swissprot (E=7.5e-31, 100% id). No structural relative anywhere in the PDB or clustered AFDB",
  "AlphaFold model of human ANXA2R","A disordered query returns few Foldseek hits by construction, so this is consistent with but not independent of the disorder result"),
 ("This work (Ensembl Compara ENSG00000177721)","evolutionary","refutes","the putative membrane anchor is conserved",
  "Orthologues in 18 eutherian species only, none in mouse, rat, dog or any non-mammal; 40-52% identity outside primates; in non-primate orthologues the hydrophobic segment 165-190 has mean identity 0.356 and the extreme C-terminus 0.286, versus 0.363 for the disordered linker 78-148",
  "Ensembl release orthology, 37 pairwise protein alignments","Compara ortholog calls for fast-evolving short ORFs can be incomplete; absence in mouse may be a calling failure rather than true absence"),
 ("PMID:30833792","interaction / localization","competing (intracellular)","ANXA2R is a plasma-membrane protein",
  "All 8 IntAct records for Q3ZCQ2 come from this ISG interactome: ANXA2R pulls down the cytoplasmic CCR4-NOT deadenylase complex (CNOT1 score 0.54, CNOT3, CNOT7, CNOT9, CNOT6L) and TNKS1BP1; CNOT1 association is additionally supported by confocal microscopy",
  "Human cells, GFP/affinity-purification MS plus confocal imaging","Affinity purification of a tagged bait; CCR4-NOT is a frequent AP-MS background, so the interaction itself is low-confidence, but the assay context is intracellular"),
 ("Human Protein Atlas ENSG00000177721 (HPA051482)","localization / database","refutes","ANXA2R is at the plasma membrane",
  "HPA protein class 'Predicted intracellular proteins'; immunofluorescence subcellular location Nucleoplasm (main), Cytosol, Cytoplasmic bodies, reliability 'Approved'; no plasma-membrane location; secretome location: none",
  "Human cell lines, immunofluorescence with a single antibody","Single-antibody IF, no independent antibody validation; database-level evidence"),
 ("UniProt Q3ZCQ2 CAUTION (ECO:0000305)","review / database","supports","the 2006 type I topology claim is unreliable",
  "'PubMed:16895901 reports that it is a type I membrane protein. However, no clear transmembrane region is detected by prediction methods, suggesting that its localization at the plasma membrane is unsure'",
  "UniProt curator assessment","Curator inference, consistent with this analysis"),
 ("InterPro IPR031449 / Pfam PF15721 / PANTHER PTHR38820","review / database","competing (circular)","GO:0038023 signaling receptor activity is independently supported",
  "The only GO MF besides protein binding is GO:0038023 (IEA, GO_REF:0000002) inherited from InterPro IPR031449, an ANXA2R-only family whose name derives from PMID:16895901. No sequence or structural feature underlies the term",
  "Database-level, human","Circular carry-over of the 2006 claim into an automatic annotation"),
], columns=["citation","evidence_type","stance","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_limitations"])
evid.to_csv(f"{OUT}/anxa2r_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("\nEvidence matrix rows:", len(evid))

go = pd.DataFrame([
 ("GO:0038023","signaling receptor activity","MF","IEA from InterPro IPR031449 (GO_REF:0000002)","REMOVE / do not accept",
  "The InterPro family is ANXA2R-only and is named after PMID:16895901; no signal peptide, no TM segment, no lipid anchor, no folded ectodomain, no structural relative. Circular annotation."),
 ("GO:0005886","plasma membrane","CC","asserted in PMID:16895901 ('type I membrane receptor protein')","DO NOT ADD (or remove if present)",
  "Topology was asserted from a 26-kDa band in transfected HEK293, never mapped. Sequence has no signal peptide and dG(app) +3.7 kcal/mol for the best 19-aa window. HPA IF places the protein in nucleoplasm/cytosol."),
 ("GO:0016020 / GO:0016021","membrane / integral component of membrane","CC","none currently","DO NOT ADD",
  "No TM-compatible segment at any window length 17-25."),
 ("GO:0005737","cytoplasm","CC","HPA IF (cytosol, cytoplasmic bodies); PMID:30833792 confocal co-localization with CNOT1","CANDIDATE ADD, curator verification needed",
  "Supported by localization and by the intracellular assay context of the only interaction dataset. Evidence is database-level IF plus one tagged-bait study."),
 ("GO:0005634","nucleus","CC","HPA IF main location nucleoplasm","CANDIDATE ADD with low confidence",
  "Single-antibody IF only; needs a second antibody or a tagged-endogenous line."),
 ("GO:0005515","protein binding","MF","IPI with CNOT1 (PMID:30833792)","RETAIN as non-core, do not promote",
  "Uninformative; AP-MS of a tagged bait with a complex that is common AP-MS background."),
 ("GO:0045672 / osteoclast differentiation terms","positive regulation of osteoclast differentiation","BP","PMID:16895901 antibody-blocking","TREAT AS NON-CORE / uncertain",
  "Downstream cellular phenotype in primary marrow cultures, inferred from a polyclonal antibody against a protein whose surface exposure is unsupported. Not a direct gene-product activity."),
], columns=["GO_id","term","aspect","current_basis","recommended_action","rationale"])
go.to_csv(f"{OUT}/anxa2r_GO_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("GO decision rows:", len(go))

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13,9))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1,1], hspace=0.38, wspace=0.28)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
col={"membrane":"#2b6cb0","query":"#c53030","soluble":"#718096"}
b=bench.sort_values("min_dG19_kcal_mol")
ax.barh(range(len(b)), b["min_dG19_kcal_mol"], color=[col[c] for c in b["class"]])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(b))); ax.set_yticklabels(b["gene"],fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(0,c="k",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("most favourable 19-aa dG(app) of translocon insertion (kcal/mol)")
ax.set_title("ANXA2R sits with soluble proteins, not membrane proteins",fontsize=10)
ax.text(0.2,0.5,"inserts",fontsize=8,color="#2b6cb0",rotation=90,va="center")
for i,(v,g) in enumerate(zip(b["min_dG19_kcal_mol"],b["gene"])):
    ax.text(v+(0.15 if v>0 else -0.15), i, f"{v:+.2f}", va="center", ha="left" if v>0 else "right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-6,10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
ax.scatter(bench["max_KD19"],bench["min_dG19_kcal_mol"],
           c=[col[c] for c in bench["class"]], s=70, zorder=3)
for _,r in bench.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(r["gene"],(r["max_KD19"],r["min_dG19_kcal_mol"]),fontsize=8,
                xytext=(4,4),textcoords="offset points")
ax.axhline(0,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); ax.axvline(1.6,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("max Kyte-Doolittle (w=19)"); ax.set_ylabel("min dG(app) 19-aa (kcal/mol)")
ax.set_title("Two independent membrane-anchor criteria agree",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q3ZCQ2",timeout=90).json()[0]
m=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
pl=[float(l[60:66]) for l in m.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"]
x=np.arange(1,len(pl)+1)
ax.plot(x,pl,color="#6b46c1",lw=1.7)
ax.axhspan(0,50,color="#fed7d7",alpha=.6); ax.axhspan(50,70,color="#feebc8",alpha=.6); ax.axhspan(70,90,color="#c6f6d5",alpha=.6)
ax.axvspan(162,187,color="#f6e05e",alpha=.3)
ax.text(163,93,"sole helix (162-187)\ndG(app) = +1.9 to +3.7",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,193)
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_title(f"AF-Q3ZCQ2-F1: mean pLDDT {np.mean(pl):.1f}, no residue above 90",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); ax.axis("off")
txt = ("Structural and evolutionary summary\n"
       "\n"
       f"Foldseek 3Di-AA vs pdb100:        0 hits\n"
       f"Foldseek 3Di-AA vs afdb50:        0 hits\n"
       f"Foldseek vs afdb-swissprot:       self only\n"
       f"Pfam / PANTHER / InterPro:        ANXA2R-only families\n"
       f"Rg(CA) of AlphaFold model:        38.3 A\n"
       f"  folded 193-aa globule expected: 16.3 A\n"
       f"  random coil expected:           42.6 A\n"
       f"Ensembl orthologues:              18 eutherian species\n"
       f"  mouse / rat / dog / non-mammal: none called\n"
       f"Non-primate identity, res 165-190: 0.356\n"
       f"Non-primate identity, res  78-148: 0.363\n"
       f"  (anchor no more constrained than linker)\n"
       "\n"
       "Localization evidence\n"
       "HPA IF (HPA051482, Approved): nucleoplasm,\n"
       "  cytosol, cytoplasmic bodies. No plasma membrane.\n"
       "HPA protein class: predicted intracellular.\n"
       "IntAct (PMID 30833792): CCR4-NOT complex\n"
       "  (CNOT1/3/7/9/6L) + TNKS1BP1, all cytoplasmic.")
ax.text(0,1,txt,fontsize=9,family="monospace",va="top")
fig.suptitle("ANXA2R (Q3ZCQ2): no sequence, structural or evolutionary basis for a cell-surface receptor",fontsize=12)
plt.show()
